hypothesis: After resolving thickness interfaces, a final-part stability objective may or may not differ from both service-static and first-frequency strong baselines. No positive outcome is required.
selection: Re-evaluate all85 same-mass designs at each of4/6/8 spatial subdivisions. At each level recalculate service constraints relative to that level's uniform plate. Select on finest level; no declaring a failed coarse optimum feasible.
interpretation: Exploration, not preregistered confirmation. Already observed global-polynomial failure motivated this discretization. No measured plate parameters, process removal, stresses, buckling, ribs or real toolpath included.
